mentions.name: Handwriting feedback app (Android)
mentions.description: This Android app gives feedback on handwriting: the user writes on paper, takes a picture, and the app uses an LLM to analyze it and provide specific feedback on what to improve. It offers 5 free tries per month due to LLM API costs; no iPhone version yet.
mentions.problem: Poor handwriting that generic advice like "try harder" or "make it neater" doesn't help improve, because it doesn't point out what specifically to fix
mentions.audience: The author's 8-year-old son, a student whose poor handwriting is affecting his exams
mentions.source_excerpt: So I created an Android app for this (no iphone for now): you write on paper, take a picture and get feedback on what to improve

evidence.value: So I created an Android app for this (no iphone for now): you write on paper, take a picture and get feedback on what to improve
